row.notes: Decal type carousel (bindings decal_types/selected_decal_type): obtains CareerSponsorsComponent in team_hq/my_team_setup (reads +0x298..+0x2a0, 0x88 stride), walks a decal tree and builds one VM row per entry (texture/show_texture/locked/loyalty_required) from provider 0x1416d4910; keeps only entries whose item +0x40 byte / +0x42 u16 equal the key at 0x146066bf0 (sponsor-category decals). locked/loyalty_required come only from unreached loyalty levels (loyalty_required = level index + 1); a decal only in default_decals is unlocked. Tree loop site 0x1416d2f83 (rax entry, [rax+0xc8] item, *(*(item+0x30)+0x10) texture); rsi = 0 takes skip path 0x1416d40e0 (in-order tree successor via rbp); shown-entry counter only advances for built rows.
